semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company acts as a distributor of semiconductor process components and equipment, primarily focusing on silicone products.
summary: WACOM Taiwan Co., Ltd. operates as a distributor of semiconductor process components and equipment, while also manufacturing high-quality silicone rubber products. The company serves as a sales base for the Watanabe Shogyo Group, focusing on both established and new product development in the semiconductor sector.
technical_expertise: Supply chain management in semiconductor distribution

regional_presence.Taiwan: Established a sales and manufacturing base in Taiwan as part of the Group's Asian expansion.
